# GAMEPLAY REALITY AUDIT

Version: 1.0

Status: Mandatory

Priority: CRITICAL

---

# PURPOSE

Validate the actual implementation of the game against assumptions made by the production pipeline.

The objective is to prevent production, validation and integration work from being driven by incorrect assumptions.

This prompt validates:

- actual gameplay
- actual renderer behavior
- actual animation usage
- actual runtime states
- actual atlas contents

This prompt does NOT create any new sprite.

This prompt does NOT modify any existing sprite.

This prompt does NOT integrate any change.

This prompt only establishes verified reality.

---

# BACKGROUND

Previous reviews revealed that several assumptions about the project were incorrect.

Examples:

- INTERACT was assumed to be a real animation family.
- COLLECT was assumed to be a potential carry cycle.
- PUSH was assumed to be a dedicated state.
- CLIMB was assumed to be a dedicated state.
- Toy Room carry behavior was assumed to use a carry animation.

Gameplay inspection disproved these assumptions.

Future production must be based on verified facts.

Never assumptions.

---

# AUDIT RULES

Inspect:

- source atlas
- OFFICIAL_FRAMES
- runtime behavior
- renderers
- state machines
- gameplay systems

All findings must be supported by evidence.

---

# AUDIT AREA 01
# INTERACT

## Objective

Determine whether INTERACT is a real animation family.

---

## Validation

Inspect:

- atlas extraction
- OFFICIAL_FRAMES
- runtime references
- renderer usage

---

## Questions

How many frames exist?

Are multiple frames present?

Is a complete animation cycle present?

Is the state referenced by gameplay?

Is the state animated?

---

## Deliverables

Generate:

interact-sheet.png

interact-report.md

interact-report.json

---

## Classification

Choose exactly one:

REAL_STATE

or

ISOLATED_ARTIFACT

---

## Failure Indicators

Single frame only.

Partial crop.

Residual pixels.

Unused extraction.

Runtime not referencing state.

---

# AUDIT AREA 02
# COLLECT

## Objective

Determine whether COLLECT may be used as a carry reference.

Distinguish the single atlas pose from runtime state composition. The source art is not a locomotion cycle; collecting while moving must continue to render the active movement cycle rather than freeze on that pose.

---

## Validation

Inspect:

- collect frames
- runtime usage
- renderer usage
- gameplay meaning

---

## Questions

Does the atlas contain a COLLECT locomotion cycle?

When `isCollecting` is active and the player moves on the ground, does runtime continue the RUN cycle?

When the player is airborne while collecting, does runtime continue JUMP/FALL?

When the player is stationary on the ground, may runtime show the isolated COLLECT pose?

Does collect contain idle?

Does collect contain run?

Does collect contain jump?

Does collect contain fall?

---

## Deliverables

collect-sheet.png

collect-analysis.md

collect-analysis.json

---

## Classification

Choose exactly one:

VALID_REFERENCE

or

NON_REFERENCE

---

## Failure Indicators

Single pickup gesture presented as a complete CARRY cycle.

Static transitional pose used as a locomotion cycle.

The isolated COLLECT source image overrides RUN/JUMP/FALL while the player is moving.

---

# AUDIT AREA 03
# TOY ROOM TRANSPORT

## Objective

Determine how transport currently works.

---

## Validation

Inspect:

ToyRoomEntities

ToyCarryPresentation

renderToyCarry

runtime footage

renderers

---

## Questions

What is currently drawn for the upper body and legs during transport?

Does the renderer use a complete, direction-aware CARRY cycle?

Do both torso and legs animate during movement?

Is the current composition a partial placeholder, and which parts remain static?

---

## Deliverables

transport-runtime.gif

transport-state-report.md

transport-state-report.json

---

## Classification

Choose exactly one:

FULL_CARRY_EXISTS

or

PLACEHOLDER_IMPLEMENTATION

---

## Failure Indicators

Position changes.

Character moves.

Only a small lower-leg crop animates while the upper body remains static.

No complete, direction-aware CARRY cycle is used.

The old whole-body fixed RUN[4] placeholder returns.

## Objective

## Outputs

↓

↓

---

## Example

↓

pickup gesture

↓

Prompt 02

↓

Collection while moving

↓

The isolated COLLECT pose must not replace temporal RUN/JUMP/FALL.

↓

↓

---

Toy Room Carry

↓

Static carry upper-body composition with an animated crop of official RUN legs; no complete directional CARRY cycle.

↓

---

# VERIFIED FACTS

Generate:

verified-gameplay-facts.md

---

## Required Format

FACT-001

Statement

Evidence

---

FACT-002

Statement

Evidence

---

The goal is to create a permanent repository of verified gameplay truths.

## Factual corrections validated in the follow-up E2E

Preserve these distinctions in generated reports and all downstream prompts:

- COLLECT has one isolated source pose and is not a locomotion cycle or CARRY reference.
- During grounded collection with movement, the runtime selects the animated RUN cycle; while airborne, JUMP/FALL prevail. The isolated COLLECT pose may appear while grounded and stationary (or after victory), but must not freeze active movement.
- The current Toy Room carry renderer is partial, not a fully frozen RUN[4]: with `toy-room-carry-pose-v1` loaded, its upper body remains in a static carry pose while a crop of the official RUN legs animates. No complete directional CARRY cycle or dedicated carry idle/jump/fall is integrated.
- The start-screen label “Dificuldade da nova aventura” is black on a dark panel and has insufficient contrast. This is a separate UI finding; sprite palette must not be changed to compensate.

---

# REQUIRED DECISIONS

The audit must answer:

Is INTERACT a production target?

YES / NO

---

Is COLLECT a carry reference?

YES / NO

---

Does a real carry state already exist?

YES / NO

---

Does PUSH require future production?

YES / NO

---

Does CLIMB require future production?

YES / NO

---

Does Toy Room currently use a carry cycle?

YES / NO

---

# APPROVAL CRITERIA

All audit areas completed.

All evidence generated.

All reports generated.

All classifications assigned.

All verified facts documented.

Pipeline impact review completed.

---

# FAILURE CRITERIA

Missing evidence.

Missing audit area.

Assumptions presented as facts.

Runtime behavior not inspected.

State classifications absent.

---

# BLOCKING RULE

Prompt 02 may not begin until this audit is approved.

Any prompt that assumes nonexistent animation families must be revised before execution.

---

# REQUIRED OUTPUTS

interact-report.md

collect-analysis.md

transport-state-report.md

push-analysis.md

climb-analysis.md

runtime-state-inventory.md

pipeline-impact-review.md

verified-gameplay-facts.md

gameplay-reality-audit.md

gameplay-reality-audit.json

---

# FINAL GOAL

All future animation work must be based on:

actual gameplay

actual renderer behavior

actual state usage

actual atlas contents

actual runtime evidence

Never on labels.

Never on comments.

Never on assumptions.
